_说明: Foundry 官方数据中的 NPC 条目待译文字。键为官方 id 与字段路径；只翻译值，保留 HTML 标签、数字和 {VAL} 这类占位符。术语按 source/fvtt/README.md 的对照表（准度、回避、HP、护盾等）。同一模板名（如 Horror）在模板与特性中要译成同一个词。

npct_horror.name: Horror
npct_horror.description: Artificial horrors beyond human comprehension. From biosynth-hybrid mechs and nanite-swarm gestalt-schools to phase-shifted tachyon phantoms. A horror may come in many forms, but those that are forced to face one in combat will always recognize it for what it is.

npct_industrial_mech.name: Industrial
npct_industrial_mech.description: Civilian machines built for mining and construction are much more numerous in the galaxy than those purpose-built for combat. Despite their obvious shortcomings, those with little alternatives will often pilot these chassis into battle, turning tools meant to create into tools used to destroy.

npct_commando_spec_op.name: Spec Op
npct_commando_spec_op.description: Expertly trained and equipped individuals that often deploy in teams to increase their deadly potential even further. Those that end up on the wrong side of such a strike team should exercise extreme caution.

npcf_abomination_horror.name: Abominable
npcf_abomination_horror.effect: Scan doesn’t reveal any information about the Horror except that they are a Horror.

npcf_mutations_horror.name: Mutations
npcf_mutations_horror.effect: The Horror may choose 1 option from the Horror Mutations list plus an additional option per tier.

npcf_quadruped_horror.name: Quadruped
npcf_quadruped_horror.effect: The Horror gains Immunity to Prone and may move up to 4 spaces as a protocol.

npcf_superfluous_extremeties_horror.name: Superfluous Extremities
npcf_superfluous_extremeties_horror.effect: The Horror gains +1 Accuracy to Grapple and may perform Improvised Attack as a quick action.

npcf_artificial_horror.name: Artificial
npcf_artificial_horror.effect: This trait can only be applied if the Horror is Biological. The Horror is no longer Biological and gains Heat Cap 6.

npcf_terrifying_horror.name: Terrifying
npcf_terrifying_horror.effect: Attacks against the Horror suffer +1 Difficulty if the attacker has line of sight to the target.

npcf_abhorrent_redundancies_horror.name: Abhorrent Redundancies
npcf_abhorrent_redundancies_horror.effect: Whenever the Horror is reduced to 0 HP, they may roll 1d6. On a 5+, they return to 1 HP and gain {3/4/5} Overshield. After this trait triggers once, it only triggers again on a 6+.

npcf_assimilaiton_maw_horror.name: Assimilation Maw
npcf_assimilaiton_maw_horror.effect: Additionally, if the Horror destroys another character with this weapon, allied or hostile, or hits a wreck, they regain {10/15/20} HP. Wrecks and allies are automatically hit by this weapon. Wrecks hit by this weapon are automatically destroyed.
npcf_assimilaiton_maw_horror.on_hit: If the target is at half or less HP after this attack is resolved, they must succeed on a Hull save or be reduced to 0 HP.

npcf_phase_shift_generator_horror.name: Phase-Shift Generator
npcf_phase_shift_generator_horror.effect: As a protocol, the Horror may become Intangible until the start of their next turn. Alternatively they may clear Intangible. The Horror may not become Intangible if they used this system on their last turn.

npcf_construction_tools_industrial_mech.name: Construction Tools
npcf_construction_tools_industrial_mech.effect: The Industrial may pick a weapon from the Industrial Weapons list. They may take a second but must replace one of their base weapons when doing so.

npcf_civilian_machine_industrial_mech.name: Civilian Machine
npcf_civilian_machine_industrial_mech.effect: The Industrial receives +1 Difficulty on saves and checks. Tech attacks gain +1 Accuracy against the Industrial.

npcf_bulky_construction_industrial_mech.name: Bulky Construction
npcf_bulky_construction_industrial_mech.effect: The Industrial gains +1 Armor but Boost becomes a full action instead of a quick action.

npcf_rock_drill_industrial_mech.name: Rock Drill
npcf_rock_drill_industrial_mech.effect: Additionally, the Industrial may automatically deal 50 AP kinetic damage to an adjacent piece of terrain as a quick action.

npcf_industrial_clamps_industrial_mech.name: Industrial Clamps
npcf_industrial_clamps_industrial_mech.effect: The Industrial gains +1 Accuracy to Grapple. This weapon automatically hits Grappled characters.

npcf_rivet_cannon_industrial_mech.name: Rivet Cannon
npcf_rivet_cannon_industrial_mech.effect: This Attack can make {1/2/3} attacks. If one of these attacks knocks a character back into a piece of terrain that stops their movement, they become Immobilized until the end of their next turn.

npcf_buzzsaw_industrial_mech.name: Buzzsaw
npcf_buzzsaw_industrial_mech.effect: On critical hit: This weapon’s base damage is doubled.

npcf_wrecker_industrial_mech.name: Wrecker
npcf_wrecker_industrial_mech.effect: Whenever this weapon is used to attack it attacks all characters within Threat.

npcf_operatives_spec_op.name: Operatives
npcf_operatives_spec_op.effect: When choosing optional systems and traits, the Spec Ops can also choose from the Spec Ops Systems and Traits list. Additionally, the Spec Ops can’t take the Grunt, Elite, or Ultra templates.

npcf_active_camo_spec_op.name: Active Camo
npcf_active_camo_spec_op.effect: As a protocol, the Spec Ops may expend a charge to become Invisible until the end of their next turn. For the duration of this effect, the Spec Ops’ next melee or ranged attack becomes a critical hit if it hits.

npcf_deadly_precision_spec_op.name: Deadly Precision
npcf_deadly_precision_spec_op.effect: The Spec Ops deals +{2/3/3} bonus damage on critical hits.

npcf_coordinated_carnage_spec_op.name: Coordinated Carnage
npcf_coordinated_carnage_spec_op.effect: After all Spec Ops characters have taken their turns in a round, a single Spec Ops character may take an additional turn in the usual turn order.

npcf_full_spectrum_sensor_suite_spec_op.name: Full-Spectrum Sensor Suite
npcf_full_spectrum_sensor_suite_spec_op.effect: The Spec Ops may Lock On as a protocol. Whenever an allied Spec Ops character within Range 10 consumes any Lock On, their attack is not affected by cover. This system can only be taken by one Spec Ops per combat.

npcf_automated_battlefield_awareness_nod.name: Automated Battlefield Awareness Node
npcf_automated_battlefield_awareness_nod.effect:
The Spec Ops gains the Battlefield Awareness reaction, which can be used any number of times per round. This system can only be taken by one Spec Ops per combat.
Battlefield Awareness
Trigger: An allied Spec Ops character within Range 8 and line of sight would roll a save.
Effect: They automatically succeed on the save before rolling any dice.

npcf_serrated_machete_spec_op.name: Serrated Machete
npcf_serrated_machete_spec_op.effect: On critical hit: The target becomes Shredded until the end of their next turn.

npcf_special_munitions_spec_op.name: Special Munitions
npcf_special_munitions_spec_op.effect:
This character’s Ranged Attacks gain “On critical hit: The target is knocked Prone.”
Additionally, before making a Ranged Attack that deals Kinetic, Energy, or Explosive Damage, the Spec Ops may swap that damage type for one of the other two.

npcf_bulwark_mods_spec_op.name: Bulwark Mods
npcf_bulwark_mods_spec_op.effect: The Spec Ops ignores difficult and dangerous terrain.

npcf_burst_jets_spec_op.name: Jump Packs
npcf_burst_jets_spec_op.effect: The Spec Ops can fly whenever it Boosts. It must end this movement on a solid surface or begin falling.

npcf_null_perception_coating_spec_op.name: Null-Perception Coating
npcf_null_perception_coating_spec_op.effect: The Spec Ops gains Immunity to Lock On.

npcf_void_rend.name: VOID REND
npcf_void_rend.effect:
This system creates a tear in reality in an adjacent free space that lasts until the end of the scene. The tear is not an object or character, does not provide obstruction, and cannot be interacted with in any way.

Characters that enter a space occupied by a tear may choose to leave realspace and enter a strange, gray, interstitial realm in which they can no longer see or interact with the real world. Characters that leave realspace in this way are removed from the battlefield entirely and cannot return for the remainder of the scene.
